country_derivation.rule: Documented empty canton denotes LI; the 26 observed Swiss canton labels denote CH. Unexpected labels remain unresolved.
country_derivation.basis: Product information January 2026, attribute catalogue page 7; product coverage page 4.

identity.basis: Product information pages 5-7: LOCALITYID is a locality GUID but is absent from this CSV; ZIP_ID identifies PLZ6 and is assigned by Swiss Post (ONRP).
identity.rule: One row per locality/postcode/municipality association. source_record identifies an extraction record within this pinned input, never an authoritative locality. Do not merge by name, PLZ4, ZIP_ID or municipality; cross-postcode locality identity remains unreviewed.

draft_and_manifest.normalization: Source names/postcodes/IDs/admin labels are verbatim. Derived matching name: boundary trim/NFC/casefold. Derived postcode key: boundary trim only; strings never coerced to integers. No translations, aliases or splitting of multilingual source names.
draft_and_manifest.variants: Only the source-provided Ortschaftsname is retained; CSV has no separate short/index-name fields. No variants are fabricated from Sprache or slash-separated text.
draft_and_manifest.source_date_minimization: CSV Validity denotes locality-name effective date and is omitted; no fictitious verification/review/freshness date. Omitted E/N/Adressenanteil are retained only in exact source bytes, never normalized draft.
draft_and_manifest.duplicate_semantics: Duplicate observations apply to included records and remain included. Exact source repeats also count among retained-association repeats; counts overlap and are not additional dispositions. No duplicate occurred in this snapshot.

coverage.scope: Official localities/building-address postcodes; not all postal purposes.
coverage.omissions: Non-address/administrative postcode types, including PO-box/company/internal postcodes, are omitted; see publisher product FAQ and technical documentation.

identity_findings: 5716 data records represent associations, not a claim of 5716 distinct localities. ZIP_ID is a PLZ6/ONRP source identifier, not a locality GUID.
1206 postal IDs have multiple municipality associations and 167 span canton labels; all associations preserved. No ZIP_ID core country/name/postcode/additional-number conflict found.
CSV has no country column; CH/LI are explicitly derived using documented canton semantics. Blank canton occurs on 20 records assigned LI; remaining 5696 retain source Swiss canton labels.
No source PLZ4 begins with zero in this snapshot; small parser fixtures verify leading-zero/boundary preservation, and source additional-number strings such as 00 remain strings.
Zero unresolved data records does not resolve cross-postcode locality identity or approve country/source/release semantics.
